Do you enjoy turning complex business requirements into clear, practical software solutions? Join Keylane as a Business Analyst and help shape the pension processes that support people through important life events, from retirement to disability and the loss of a loved one.

Key about your team

You will join Life Events, an area of approximately 70 colleagues working at the heart of Plexus, our pension platform. We are organised into three teams that support pension processes related to retirement, death and disability, as well as premium and benefit calculations. You will be part of Life Events B, a team with 30 colleagues across Denmark, Netherlands and India. Our developers, testers and business analysts work closely together throughout the development process, from planning to delivery. Guided by client needs, we combine business knowledge and technical expertise to deliver a standardised, consistent solution across clients and countries.

Key about your role

As a Business Analyst in the Life Events department, you will work closely with our Product Owner, Development team, and and Delivery to ensure our products continue being the leading solutions. You will analyse and elaborate requirements coming in from our customers via Delivery and help evolve and design a standard solution to support customer’s needs.

You will have responsibility of tasks that include:

• Analysing business requirements for pension processes and translating them into clear development and test tasks.

• Shaping functional solutions and guiding developers throughout implementation within Life Events— Ranging from supporting brand new processes within the system, to help defining the implementation of new calculations.

• Demoing new features and enhancements to stakeholders.

• Supporting in quality assurance, through testing and bug intake.

Key About you

We are looking for someone who enjoys working with complex systems, customers and calculations, and thrives on collaborating across international teams.

Ideally, you have:

• An educational background in pension, math, IT or a related field.

• At least +5 years experience with software projects.

• Experience with or knowledge of the pension industry – this is a strong advantage.

• Experience with SQL or are comfortable working with databases and data analysis is a plus.

• Have a hands-on mindset, take ownership, and are comfortable driving tasks and issues forward.

• Strong numerical and analytical skills, as many of the tasks involve working extensively with data and calculations.

• Experience gathering and breaking down complex requirements into actionable tasks within IT projects.

• Communicate confidently in English.

Using AI

• You have used AI-assisted development tools, such as Claude, ChatGPT, Codex, GitHub Copilot or Cursor, in your work or your own projects.

What we offer

• A flat and informal organization with a professional and supportive working environment.

• A profit share.

• Inclusion days where you decide when to hold your public holidays.

• Five weeks of vacation and five Keylane days.

• A pension scheme where 13.25% is paid by Keylane and the individual contribution is 3%.

• Flexibility in the working environment. We offer a combination of working from home and from the office. We value seeing colleagues in person to stay connected and collaborate effectively.

• The Danish office is located a 10-minute walk from Islands Brygge Metro station.

• We believe that strong employee relations are key to maintaining well-being in the workplace. To support this, we offer a variety of social activities that all employees can participate in, such as yoga, padel tennis, running, outdoor bathing, and fitness in the basement.

• Salary: For this role, the Monthly Base Salary ranges from 50.000-60.000 (DKK), corresponding to the level of the position. The placement within the salary range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate’s skills, competencies, knowledge, and relevant experience.

*Please submit your application, including your CV. Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis.

*A criminal record and reference check are part of the application process. Each employee within Keylane must follow training on information security and irrespective to the role basic information security responsibilities apply.

If you have any questions about the job, you are very welcome to Martin Bo Heiberg, manager martin.bo.heiberg@keylane.com

If you have any questions, please send an email to manager of the team, or Talent Acquisition Specialist, Lykke Kæstel Alsgren at lykke.alsgren@keylane.com.

Join us in this role where you’ll be part of a highly motivated, dynamic and social team focusing on financial lifecycle cost analysis of future and existing offshore wind projects. You’ll obtain key insights into our development pipeline and existing fleet where you will ensure best-in-class financial and investment support for our global offshore organization.

We are looking for an OPEX Financial Analyst with exceptional analytical skills to transform complex datasets into actionable insights. Proficiency in Excel and the ability to present findings clearly to various stakeholders are essential.

**Welcome to Technical Budgeting and Analysis

**You’ll be part of a team where you, together with your colleagues, will develop and benchmark operational lifetime budgets for our existing and future wind farms.

As a team, we will provide all analysis of OPEX cost and support management in taking decisions based on financial and business insights.

**You’ll play an important role in:

**

• taking ownership of your own portfolio of offshore wind projects and the responsibility to support our Offshore business with lifecycle cost assessments and financial analysis

• providing lifecycle cost assessment and financial analysis to our development projects during Bid, FID and maturation phase (incl. risk-, FX- and local content analysis)

• providing relevant high-quality financial analysis on OPEX activities for commercial decision support as well as presenting and reporting to senior management

• working with our M&A Valuation & Structuring team to support our divestment processes through quantitative evaluation of various O&M activities and concepts.

**To succeed in the role, you:

**

• have keen interest in business and cost analysis and are curious to understand fundamental financial drivers behind the business case of an offshore wind farm

• have relevant work experience in the field of lifetime cost modelling, budget forecasting, financial analysis or similar

• thrive in an international, dynamic and fast paced, project environment where you keep the financial overview to ensure the integrity of our business cases and financial commitments

• have a positive can-do attitude and excellent communication skills to ensure complex financial matters are understood by all stakeholders and management

• are highly proficient in Excel and PowerPoint, enjoy working with large financial models and have a proactive mindset towards change.

Maybe you’ve read the above and can see you have some transferable skills, even though they don’t quite match all the points. If you think you can bring something to the team, we still encourage you to apply.

**Position salary range:

**For this role, the base pay will be determined according to the relevant pay structure for the location where the position is filled. Actual pay will be based on skills, experience, and the expected role fulfilment to ensure a fair and competitive offer. Where applicable, you may also be eligible for variable payment and a comprehensive benefits package. Pay details specific to your location will be provided during the interview process.

**Pre-employment background checks:

**For certain positions, a background check may be required as part of the hiring process. Because we recruit across multiple countries, the specific checks performed will depend on the role and the legal requirements in the location where the position is filled. If a background check is relevant for the role you are being considered for, you will be informed during the recruitment process. All background checks are carried out by an external provider and always in accordance with applicable local laws and regulations.

Veo is an AI-powered sports camera and analysis ecosystem built for one job: turning what happens on a pitch into proof. Capture, viewing, data and analytics, sharing- all in one system, all pointed at the same thing.

That's bigger than football. Every player, on every pitch, gets access to the kind of proof only the top academies used to keep for themselves. It's the future we're building.

Every youth match still has a moment nobody saw. A run that won the game, underneath everyone's radar. A kid written off before anyone actually checked. We exist to close that gap, one match at a time.

One camera on any pitch feeds an AI that tracks every player and the ball for the whole game, turning what happened into evidence instead of somebody's opinion.

That's the actual job here. Not shipping features. Building the system that gives proof to someone who used to rely on a hunch.

If you've ever watched a match and wondered who else saw what you saw, you already know why this matters.

We're looking for people who want to build that future with us.

**The Opportunity

**The Coaching, Insights and Analysis group comprises three different teams and their mission is to help coaches and players better understand and learn from their matches through intuitive coaching and analysis tools. We’re looking for a Full-Stack Software Engineer to join us and help turn match data and video into products coaches rely on every day.

You’ll report to the Engineering Manager be part of a cross-functional product team working closely with engineers, product managers, and product designers to build and evolve these tools.

In this role, you’ll work across the stack: crafting intuitive frontend experiences, building scalable backend services, and contributing to systems that power Veo’s growing platform.

**What You Will Do

**

• Contribute across the full stack, building intuitive user interfaces while developing robust backend services and APIs.

• Take part in the full product lifecycle - from ideation and design to development, deployment, monitoring, and iteration.

• Build and maintain scalable systems that support Veo’s growing platform and user base.

• Contribute to technical discussions, architecture decisions, and data modeling that shape the long-term direction of the product.

• Ensure performance, reliability, and maintainability in the systems the team owns.

• Collaborate closely with other teams across Veo, including AI and platform teams, to integrate insights and video-driven features into the product.

• Contribute to a healthy engineering culture through collaboration, code reviews, and shared ownership of the product.

**What You Could Bring

**

• 5+ years of software engineering experience, ideally in a product-led environment.

• Experience building and operating full-stack applications, with proficiency in backend technologies such as Python, Django or PGSQL, and well as TypeScript, Node.js and React on the frontend side.

• Openness to using modern AI tools as part of software development workflows, and curiosity about how they can shape the way we design and build software systems.

• A strong sense for building products that solve real problems and deliver value to users.

• Experience designing clean, maintainable systems, with sound judgment around architectural trade-offs.

• Comfort contributing across the stack and collaborating closely with Product and Design to shape user-facing features.

• A thoughtful approach to testing, CI/CD, and maintaining production-quality systems.

• A growth mindset with curiosity for new tools, technologies, and ways of working.

• Interest in sports, video technologies, or data-driven insights is a plus.

Our Copenhagen office mirrors our innovative technology – with an indoor ball court, rooftop terrace, and well-equipped gym. We have created a facility that supports connecting disciplines across the business, facilitates creative thinking, and gives the space to engage with colleagues, our global partners, and the entire Veo community.

Values we hold at Veo:

Dare - We take initiative, stay curious, and challenge the status quo in our work.

Own it - We drive impact by identifying opportunities, taking responsibility, and confidently executing.

Level up - We embrace growth, continuously learning and shaping our skills.

Play as a team - We collaborate across a diverse organization, leveraging shared insights for stronger

outcomes.

Customer Centric - We deliver value by having close partnerships and a deep understanding of our customers (internally and externally)

We value diversity and inclusion and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, even if your experience doesn’t completely match every qualification listed. What matters most is your creativity, potential, and ability to make meaningful contributions.

Priyanka .

**Façade Engineer (Buildings and Industry)

**

**Aalborg, Aarhus, Esbjerg, Lyngby, Odense, Vejle

**

**Full-time

**

**Hybrid

**

**Do you want to bring your skills into play on innovative and multidisciplinary projects? Can you contribute to the development of the facade engineering market area? And are you motivated by building relations with colleagues, collaborators, and stakeholders? Then, this is your chance to become part of our skilled facade engineering group and contribute to the buildings of the future!

**

**Contribute to the development of façade engineering

**

The world seeks beautiful and sustainable solutions. To support customers in transforming their aspirations into realities, we are looking for a Façade Engineer to join our team of Façade Specialists. We have a good number of colleagues working alongside our customers on some of Denmark’s most significant projects in construction, such as the Water Culture House on Papirøen and the expansion of Terminal 3 at Copenhagen Airport.

Your main activity will be to participate in project design and supervision within Façade Engineering.

Other key activities will be:

• Identify the need for developing guidelines/procedures/best practices etc.

• Contribute to defining strategies for building relations with collaborators and stakeholders

• Develop external relations with customers

**Your skills. Our team. Together we design the future.

**

The first step to success in this role is that you are eager to collaborate with the people around you, whether they are colleagues, partners or customers. Developing ties with others is something you do by acting respectfully and delivering on your promises. And you never get set in your ways but keep exploring new insights and ways to improve.

On top of that, you will have:

• A degree in Structural Engineering or related field relevant to façade engineering

• At least 3 years of experience in façade engineering of building structures

• Communication skills in one of the Scandinavian languages and proficiency in English.

**A place to work and so much more

**

At COWI, we work together with our customers to shape a sustainable and liveable world. We do it by applying our knowledge and curiosity – and sometimes even our courage – to create the solutions the world needs today to enable a better tomorrow. That is why we say no to fossil-based projects and aspire to have 100% of our revenue come from activities that move our customers towards sustainability.

We value differences and development and cultivate an environment of belonging and having fun. Because that is what brings out the best in you, at work and at home.

With offices primarily located in the Nordic region, the UK, North America and India, we are currently more than 8,000 people who bring their knowledge in engineering, architecture, energy and environment into play.

**What we also offer

**

In this role, you will enjoy a rewarding job with significant freedom in a lively, international work environment, including:

• Collaborative opportunities with talented colleagues

• Attractive employment conditions

• Salary in line with industry standards based on your qualifications

• An enriching cultural experience

**Got more questions?

**

If you have any unanswered questions about the role or what we have to offer, please reach out to our Global Talent Acquisition Specialist, Priyanka, at prki@cowi.com.

Get to know us even better at our website, www.cowi.com, where you can learn more about our projects, our strategy, what we want to achieve and what life is like at COWI.

**Before you apply

**

We ask that you include your CV along with a cover letter in your application. At the interview, you’ll have the opportunity to share more about your interest in joining COWI.

**Diversity is fundamental to COWI, inclusion is key.

**

We are committed to creating a respectful and fair work environment where all employees have a sense of belonging and equitable opportunities to thrive and grow. We ensure that our leaders are role models for inclusive leadership by cultivating a culture where diverse perspectives and thoughts are seen as strengths. And we take diversity and inclusion into account in all relevant decisions and processes and when setting teams and fora. We do it because it is part of our values and because it is simply the right thing to do.

Are you experienced in JavaScript and TypeScript and ready to take the lead on Front-End development for a fast growing B2B SaaS startup? Then we will be excited to hear from you!

**Who are we?

**Supplios is a fast growing start-up based in Copenhagen, developing an all-in-one supplier portal for global manufacturers.

As a manufacturer it is highly critical to have a streamlined, compliant and data-driven supply chain. However, most manufacturers manage the majority of their supply chain with spreadsheets, e-mails and with no unified system of record for supply chain related data. Where existing tools fall short, Supplios is designed to manage the ever-growing complexities in manufacturing supply chains.

Read more about us here www.supplios.com.

Our Supplier Portal is already used by customers in both the US and Europe and we are seeing a very strong demand from new customers. Therefore, we are looking for a new colleague to take lead of our Front-End architecture and development.

**Skills & Experience

****JavaScript/TypeScript Proficiency:

**

• Strong understanding of JavaScript and TypeScript.

• Ability to write clean, maintainable, and efficient code.

**Framework Experience

**

• Experience with at least one or more JavaScript/TypeScript frameworks such as Vue, React, Angular, Svelte, Next.js, or Nuxt.js.

• Solid understanding of the pros, cons, and tradeoffs of using frameworks, with both client-side and server-side rendering.

**Enterprise Application Experience

**

• Proven experience working on large enterprise applications, demonstrating scalability and maintainability.

• Familiarity with Single Page Applications (SPA), Progressive Web Applications (PWA), and responsive design.

**Testing & Methodologies

**

• Familiarity with Test-Driven Development, Behavior-Driven Development, or Domain-Driven Design.

• Proficiency in writing unit tests, integration tests, and end-to-end tests for JavaScript/TypeScript applications.

• Experience working in an Agile development environment, using practices such as Scrum or Kanban.

**Good to know

**We have a great office in the heart of Copenhagen (Pilestræde) with lunch, great coffee and plenty of space where we would like you to be as much as possible, yet we also support flexible working hours and remote working when this is needed.

To have a good time, supporting each other and delivering a world class product along with a world class customer experience is the core of our DNA, and we expect all our colleagues to contribute in building an incredible company culture.

Everything we build immediately serves real people in real companies worldwide that are making products which affect our daily lives, from cars, to food, renewable energy, and much more.

Do you love turning menus and interfaces into something players actually enjoy clicking through, and want to own that from first sketch to final implementation? We’d love to talk to you.

Triband is the award-winning studio behind the WHAT THE? comedy game series, played by millions worldwide. From our home in central Copenhagen, more than 60 wonderful humans are united by a simple mission: to make everyone laugh.

We're working on our most ambitious project to date: a new systemic open-world game built around a beloved IP, with our own spin on it. A bold new direction for us! And we're just getting started.

Now, we’re looking for a UI/UX Designer to join a team of around 15-20 people and own the UI/UX for the entire game. You’ll be the first dedicated UI/UX designer on the team (and at Triband generally!), so you’ll shape the game’s interface aesthetic and logic as well as player experience from the ground up.

**Here’s What You’ll Do Day To Day

**

• Own the full UI/UX pipeline for the game: from flow, wireframes, and mockups through to final in-engine implementation (we use Unity)

• Design and build UI elements like menus, icons, HUDs, and input controls that are clear, playful, and true to the game’s tone

• Bake in accessibility design and settings from the start, not as an afterthought

• Create dynamic transitions and animations that make the UI feel alive

• Implement your own designs solidly in Unity (you won’t be just handing off mockups!)

• Collaborate closely with game designers and programmers to keep the UI consistent, technically sound, and fun to use

• Maintain a consistent visual language and set of UI standards as the game grows

**You’re probably a good match if

**

• You have solid experience owning UI/UX work end to end, from flow through to final implementation

• You have strong Unity implementation skills and are comfortable taking your own UI work all the way into engine

• You’re skilled in Illustrator

• You have experience mocking up interactive flows in a tool like Figma, Miro, or similar (any tool is fine)

• You genuinely enjoy working within an existing visual style rather than starting from a blank page every time

• You’ve shipped a mobile game before, including responsive/adaptive interfaces

• You have a strong eye for color, shapes, contrast, and readability

**Nice to have

**

• A passion for accessibility and usability, especially for family-friendly/casual audiences

• You see real value in user testing and what it can teach you

• An interest in motion design and UI animation

**What Always Matters To Us At Triband

**This project is something new, but our ways of working are the same. We’ve always believed that games are made by teams, not solo rockstars, and good ideas can come from anyone. What we also believe in:

• You thrive in taking ownership of your area: you spot problems, seek advice when needed, and implement creative solutions that push projects forward.

• You’re motivated by collaboration, mutual respect, inclusiveness, and creativity, and you actively contribute to sustaining that culture.

• You bring curiosity, generosity, and flexibility, along with strong opinions, especially when they come with reasoning, openness, and a willingness to actually test them.

• You’re up for experimentation, and at the same time you don’t get too precious when the experience tells you you’re wrong.

• You value a positive work environment and contribute to keeping the studio a fun and supportive place.

**Practicalities

**

• We work on-site at our cozy office in central Copenhagen.

• This role is based in the Greater Copenhagen area, and we’re not considering people located outside of commuting distance for this one.

• We work a 37-hour work week, with core hours 10–15, and the freedom to start and finish anywhere between 7 and 18.

• Our working language is English.

**We offer

**

• A shot at shaping the interface of a live game played by millions

• A tight, collaborative team where your ideas actually make it into the game

• A playful work environment where trying the silly idea is encouraged

• Friendly and kind colleagues who love making each other laugh as much as making games

• A professional development budget to invest in your growth

• Social activities like Friday bars, hobby nights, board game nights, and whatever else Tribanders turn into a tradition

• Daily lunch at a local restaurant, with plant-based options and soft ice on Thursdays

• Private health insurance paid by us

• Child's first sick day on us, no questions asked

• Endless amounts of Noda

**WHAT THE TRIBAND?

**Triband is the award-winning studio behind the WHAT THE? comedy game series, played by millions worldwide.

From our home in central Copenhagen, more than 60 wonderful humans are united by our mission to make people laugh. We explore comedy through gameplay, which means we like to break player expectations, create surprising interactions, use great music and slick art, and build quirky worlds full of personality.

We put people first and strive to create a safe and creative working environment. We believe that teams, not individuals, make games. And we believe diversity makes teams better. For these reasons, we look for people who bring new perspectives and who are excited to challenge us and our way of doing things.

For more info about Triband, check out: triband.net/about

To do so, we focus on exploring comedy through gameplay. We like to break player expectations, use wonderful music, slick art, and create a quirky atmosphere. We experiment a lot, and it doesn’t always work out, but we always learn something.

The role

As our Revenue Operations Manager, you'll own the processes and data behind our sales organization: the sales process, definitions, forecasting and commissions.

This is an individual contributor role in our Revenue Operations team, reporting to the Global Director, Revenue Operations & Information Security. You'll be supported by the RevOps team and work closely with sales leadership and Finance. We're looking for around 5+ years of hands-on experience in VC or PE-backed companies.

What you'll do

Forecasting

• Define shared sales terms and metrics such as pipeline, stage probabilities, bookings, and new versus expansion business.

• Establish a forecasting baseline: forecast categories, submission rules and a first method for new business and expansion.

• Track forecast accuracy and refine the method as data quality improves.

• Build pipeline and forecast reports and dashboards in Salesforce.

• Set up a pipeline and forecast review cadence with sales leadership once the definitions are in place.

Sales process

• Own the sales process from qualified opportunity to closed deal, including stages, exit criteria and the hand-over to delivery and Finance.

• Set up territories, account ownership and rules for partner and cross-sell deals.

Commissions

• Help automate the commission process with the right tooling, from data capture to calculation and payout.

• Work with Finance and sales leadership on plan design and changes.

Sales systems

• Shape how Salesforce (including Revenue Cloud/CPQ) supports the sales process, and make hands-on changes where needed.

• Keep sales data clean with required fields, validation rules and deduplication.

• Automate manual steps in the sales process with workflows and AI.

• Work with CRM vendors and implementation partners, including evaluations, renewals, support and new functionality.

• Train and support sales reps on system and process changes.

Stack harmonization

We grow through acquisition. In October 2026 we announced our combination with WoodWing, adding four products and more than 200 colleagues. Harmonizing the sales stack and processes of acquired companies is a big part of this job, done together with the RevOps team and the Global Director, Revenue Operations & Information Security.

• Bring each acquired sales team, starting with WoodWing, onto our shared sales process, pipeline stages, definitions and reporting.

• Move acquired sales reps onto group commission plans.

• Set account ownership and cross-sell rules between entities, and resolve duplicate accounts.

• Assess each acquired company's sales systems and migrate accounts, contacts, opportunities and products into Salesforce in phases, including from HubSpot.

• Build a repeatable playbook for the next acquisition.

Your qualifications

Essential

• Around 5+ years in Revenue Operations or Sales Operations in B2B SaaS

• Experience building a sales forecast from the ground up, including the definitions and data quality behind it

• Hands-on Salesforce experience, including reports, dashboards and flows

• Experience designing and rolling out sales processes

• Experience administering sales commissions

• Experience consolidating CRMs or sales processes after an acquisition, or running sales operations across several entities

• Good understanding of sales metrics such as pipeline coverage, win rates, sales cycle and bookings

• Strong analytical skills in Excel or Google Sheets

Nice to have

• HubSpot experience, including migrating from HubSpot to Salesforce

• Salesforce Revenue Cloud or CPQ experience

• Experience implementing commission software

• Using AI in sales workflows

Soft skills

You're comfortable with change and ambiguity, as our processes keep developing with each acquisition. You build trust with sales leaders and sales reps, prefer practical solutions you can improve over time, and help new colleagues adapt to shared ways of working.

What kind of company is Omnidocs?

We recognize that in different phases of life, you need different kinds of flexibility, and we are happy to provide that. It could be that you prefer to work from home once or twice a week or occasionally need to leave early for a soccer tournament, a parents’ meeting, or a romantic date. We find small talk between co-workers valuable, so your lunch break is part of your working hours, and we invest in quality coffee beans for the cozy and useful interactions across teams by the coffee machine. It may sound like little things, but the overall message is that we want you to meet trust, kindness, and helpfulness at work because we expect that this is what you bring as well. The purpose of our company is just as internal as it is externally communicated: We make every workday work better.

We also love to connect. We do social activities such as LAN parties, board game afternoons, and Friday Cafes. Our office is located in the heart of the historic neighborhood of Christianshavn, surrounded by canals and great little cafés and restaurants. We have plenty of light and air while being close to everything – including the metro, the canals, and the city center.

How to apply – important information!

As we strive to have an unbiased recruitment process, we ask you to be attentive to the following when applying.

1- Include a resume with relevant professional experience, skillset, and educational background.

2- Answer all required questions in the submission form when uploading.

3- Use the dedicated application link (do not send your resume over e-mail).

4- Do NOT share: a cover letter / motivated application a picture of yourself (if it’s part of your resume, please remove it before uploading) information about your gender or sex your first name (enter the first letter of your first name instead) your age or birth date

Processing of personal data By registering in our HR system, BambooHR, and uploading both application and CV, you accept that Omnidocs stores the registered data about you and the data included in the uploaded documents. All information is used solely for recruitment purposes and will be deleted within 12 months of upload. Please do not include person-sensitive data in the application and CV, e.g. CPR number, information about race, religion, trade union conditions, and health information. You can read about Omnidocs' guidelines for processing personal data here: https://omnidocs.com/processing-of-personal-data-in-the-context-of-recruitment/

HEGSØ Search & Consulting has the task of finding a skilled Machine Learning Engineer for our client, the leading subsea technology and development company Teledyne RESON.

Job Purpose:

Turn noisy, real-time sensor data into robust machine-learning solutions.

As Machine Learning Engineer you join a multidisciplinary engineering team developing ML for target detection, sonar imaging and pattern recognition in streaming acoustic data. Your work will connect sensors, signal processing, high-performance computing and the information ultimately presented to users.

The sensor systems generate large volumes of real-time data, which is transformed into software products for visualization, post-processing and analysis. The processing chain combines demanding real-time computation with FPGA, DSP and GPU hardware.

You will help develop both the ML models and the infrastructure around them. Because the ML infrastructure supports internal development and customer on-site use, robustness, efficiency and control are central to the role. You will work with industry-standard tools as well as in-house technology.

This is a rare opportunity to apply machine learning to difficult, meaningful data alongside maritime domain experts, software engineers, mathematical modelling engineers and embedded-processing specialists.

What makes the role distinctive:

• Challenging data – find structures and patterns in noisy streaming acoustic and hydrophone data

• End-to-end impact – work from sensor input and model development through to information presented to the user

• Industrial ML – turn novel ML technology into robust, efficient products for internal and customer use

Key Responsibilities:

• Develop machine-learning and data-science solutions for target detection in sonar acoustic data and imaging systems

• Identify structures and patterns in data from hydrophones

• Develop ML models and contribute to the ML infrastructure used in the software products

• Be an active member of a development team spanning software, mathematical modelling and dedicated embedded-processing hardware

• Communicate concepts across the development chain, from sensor input to the final information presented to the user

• Propose improvements to ML models and infrastructure

• Help bring novel ML technologies into robust, industrialized products

• Keep current with relevant technologies and tools

Essential skills:

• Experience with general machine-learning technologies, modern modelling techniques and deep-learning frameworks – PyTorch, TensorFlow or similar

• Understanding of software quality assurance principles and build tools, plus a successful track record in ML development

• Ability to manage and span substantial multi-year engineering efforts while contributing as a hands-on team player

• Strong technical communication skills and proficiency in English

Useful additional experience:

• A background in mathematics, physics or optics, with an understanding of the physics and nature of acoustics

• Experience with related signal-processing domains such as hearing aids, 5G telecom, radar or ultrasound

• Experience with relevant software and tools such as Git, Jira and build systems

Qualifications & Experience:

• An MSc or PhD in engineering is a strong foundation, but an experienced professional background can be equally relevant

• The right candidate may come from different disciplines and career paths

Behavioural Competencies:

• Self-driven, enjoys difficult technical challenges and keeps pushing toward ambitious goals

• Collaborates well and communicates well in a global team distributed between countries

• Takes ownership and responsibility, delivers to agreements and keeps promises

• Enthusiastic, energetic ‘can-do’ attitude

• Interested in new technologies, industry challenges and in the products, use cases, customers and the marine domain

What we offer:

• A collaborative workplace with strong colleagues and a company that takes good care of its employees

• A high level of ambition and the time to build high-quality products within a company recognized globally for world-class sonar systems

• A development path that supports your continued professional growth

• Interesting products, markets and customers, including leading research organizations, global industrial companies and defence organizations

About Teledyne RESON: Teledyne RESON is a world leader in high-quality underwater acoustic solutions – multibeam sonars, sensors, transducers and survey software. Founded in Denmark in 1976 and part of Teledyne since 2013, with headquarters, R&D and production in Slangerup.

Job location

Copenhagen, Denmark is preferred because close collaboration between ML and software engineers is important to the role.

If you want to know more, please contact:

Anders Hegelskov, HEGSØ Search & Consulting, Phone: +45 3035 6405 – Mail: ah@hegsoe.dk

The role

As our Revenue Operations Manager, you'll own the processes and data behind our sales organization: the sales process, definitions, forecasting and commissions.

This is an individual contributor role in our Revenue Operations team, reporting to the Global Director, Revenue Operations & Information Security. You'll be supported by the RevOps team and work closely with sales leadership and Finance. We're looking for around 5+ years of hands-on experience in VC or PE-backed companies.

What you'll do

Forecasting

• Define shared sales terms and metrics such as pipeline, stage probabilities, bookings, and new versus expansion business.

• Establish a forecasting baseline: forecast categories, submission rules and a first method for new business and expansion.

• Track forecast accuracy and refine the method as data quality improves.

• Build pipeline and forecast reports and dashboards in Salesforce.

• Set up a pipeline and forecast review cadence with sales leadership once the definitions are in place.

Sales process

• Own the sales process from qualified opportunity to closed deal, including stages, exit criteria and the hand-over to delivery and Finance.

• Set up territories, account ownership and rules for partner and cross-sell deals.

Commissions

• Help automate the commission process with the right tooling, from data capture to calculation and payout.

• Work with Finance and sales leadership on plan design and changes.

Sales systems

• Shape how Salesforce (including Revenue Cloud/CPQ) supports the sales process, and make hands-on changes where needed.

• Keep sales data clean with required fields, validation rules and deduplication.

• Automate manual steps in the sales process with workflows and AI.

• Work with CRM vendors and implementation partners, including evaluations, renewals, support and new functionality.

• Train and support sales reps on system and process changes.

Stack harmonization

We grow through acquisition. In October 2026 we announced our combination with WoodWing, adding four products and more than 200 colleagues. Harmonizing the sales stack and processes of acquired companies is a big part of this job, done together with the RevOps team and the Global Director, Revenue Operations & Information Security.

• Bring each acquired sales team, starting with WoodWing, onto our shared sales process, pipeline stages, definitions and reporting.

• Move acquired sales reps onto group commission plans.

• Set account ownership and cross-sell rules between entities, and resolve duplicate accounts.

• Assess each acquired company's sales systems and migrate accounts, contacts, opportunities and products into Salesforce in phases, including from HubSpot.

• Build a repeatable playbook for the next acquisition.

Your qualifications

Essential

• Around 5+ years in Revenue Operations or Sales Operations in B2B SaaS

• Experience building a sales forecast from the ground up, including the definitions and data quality behind it

• Hands-on Salesforce experience, including reports, dashboards and flows

• Experience designing and rolling out sales processes

• Experience administering sales commissions

• Experience consolidating CRMs or sales processes after an acquisition, or running sales operations across several entities

• Good understanding of sales metrics such as pipeline coverage, win rates, sales cycle and bookings

• Strong analytical skills in Excel or Google Sheets

Nice to have

• HubSpot experience, including migrating from HubSpot to Salesforce

• Salesforce Revenue Cloud or CPQ experience

• Experience implementing commission software

• Using AI in sales workflows

Soft skills

You're comfortable with change and ambiguity, as our processes keep developing with each acquisition. You build trust with sales leaders and sales reps, prefer practical solutions you can improve over time, and help new colleagues adapt to shared ways of working.

What kind of company is Omnidocs?

We recognize that in different phases of life, you need different kinds of flexibility, and we are happy to provide that. It could be that you prefer to work from home once or twice a week or occasionally need to leave early for a soccer tournament, a parents’ meeting, or a romantic date. We find small talk between co-workers valuable, so your lunch break is part of your working hours, and we invest in quality coffee beans for the cozy and useful interactions across teams by the coffee machine. It may sound like little things, but the overall message is that we want you to meet trust, kindness, and helpfulness at work because we expect that this is what you bring as well. The purpose of our company is just as internal as it is externally communicated: We make every workday work better.

We also love to connect. We do social activities such as LAN parties, board game afternoons, and Friday Cafes. Our office is located in the heart of the historic neighborhood of Christianshavn, surrounded by canals and great little cafés and restaurants. We have plenty of light and air while being close to everything – including the metro, the canals, and the city center.

How to apply – important information!

As we strive to have an unbiased recruitment process, we ask you to be attentive to the following when applying.

1- Include a resume with relevant professional experience, skillset, and educational background.

2- Answer all required questions in the submission form when uploading.

3- Use the dedicated application link (do not send your resume over e-mail).

4- Do NOT share: a cover letter / motivated application a picture of yourself (if it’s part of your resume, please remove it before uploading) information about your gender or sex your first name (enter the first letter of your first name instead) your age or birth date

Processing of personal data By registering in our HR system, BambooHR, and uploading both application and CV, you accept that Omnidocs stores the registered data about you and the data included in the uploaded documents. All information is used solely for recruitment purposes and will be deleted within 12 months of upload. Please do not include person-sensitive data in the application and CV, e.g. CPR number, information about race, religion, trade union conditions, and health information. You can read about Omnidocs' guidelines for processing personal data here: https://omnidocs.com/processing-of-personal-data-in-the-context-of-recruitment/

jobs.occupation: Data engineer for analytics platform with BI expertise and an interest in the green energy transition
jobs.description:
Do you want to help shape the future of Europe’s energy system and contribute to a fully carbon‑neutral, sustainable power grid? Are you a data engineer who is curious, open‑minded, and initiative-taking — someone who enjoys working in an explorative and collaborative environment? Do you want to collaborate with engineers, application developers, and data scientists to unlock insights from the vast amounts of data behind our services?

We are looking for a Data Engineer with BI expertise to join our Data and Analytics team at Nordic RCC. If you are excited about building robust data pipelines, developing high‑quality BI products, and enabling data‑driven decision‑making in a mission‑driven organization, we encourage you to apply — even if you don’t meet every requirement.

**Nordic RCC – supporting security of supply and the green energy transition

**Nordic Regional Coordination Centre (RCC) provides critical services and insights to support the national Transmission System Operators (TSOs) in Finland, Norway, Sweden and Denmark — to ensure the efficient operation and use of the Nordic power system and high security of power supply at any time.

Based in Copenhagen, Nordic RCC is one of six RCCs in Europe, equally owned by the Nordic region's four electricity TSOs: Fingrid, Statnett, Svenska Kraftnät, and Energinet.

As European power systems integrate and evolve to meet climate goals, Nordic RCC provides regional coordination, integrated services, regional insights and recommendations to the Nordic TSOs and their control centres, to support cross-border operational security 24/7.

Join Nordic RCC, a fast-developing company determined to make a significant impact in the energy sector and to provide for a secure and efficient transition to the green, sustainable energy system.

Right now, we are looking for a Data Engineer who likes to make a difference!

**Job Description

**The Data and Analytics team consists of 10 employees and consultants and plays a central role in enabling data-driven decision-making across Nordic RCC. The team develops and maintains data pipelines, analytics products, BI solutions, platform services, and information services that support operational, strategic, and regulatory needs.

As a Data Engineer with BI expertise, you will help design, build, operate, and improve our analytics platform and the data products built on it. You will work closely with data scientists, engineers, developers, infrastructure teams, external providers, and stakeholders to deliver reliable data pipelines, intuitive BI solutions, and user-friendly data services.

**Responsibilities

**Your work will directly influence how Nordic RCC uses data to improve processes, services, and operational decision-making. Your key responsibilities will include:

• Design, build, and optimize scalable data pipelines, data models, integrations, and curated datasets.

• Develop BI dashboards, reports, and data products that turn complex data into clear insights.

• Operate and improve analytics platform services, including data platforms, BI solutions, JupyterHub, user-facing analytics environments, and supporting applications.

• Ensure data quality, reliability, monitoring, and operational visibility across pipelines, BI products, and platform services.

• Monitor and optimize platform performance, resource use, computer storage, and analytical workloads.

• Collaborate with data scientists, engineers, developers, infrastructure teams, external providers, and stakeholders to deliver production-ready analytics solutions.

• Support the development of platform architecture, metadata, governance practices, and service-oriented delivery models such as Data-as-a-Service and Platform-as-a-Service.

• Document data flows, platform components, operational procedures, and technical solutions to support maintainability and knowledge sharing.

**We are looking for someone with several of the following qualifications:

**

• Minimum 5 years of experience as a Data Engineer, Analytics Engineer, BI Developer, Platform Engineer, Application Developer, or similar.

• Strong experience with ETL/ELT pipelines, modern data architectures, SQL, and data warehousing concepts.

• Hands-on experience with BI tools such as Power BI, Tableau, Qlik, or similar.

• Experience operating and optimizing analytics platforms in production environments.

• Experience with cloud-native technologies and analytics platforms such as Microsoft Azure, Databricks, Azure Synapse, Snowflake, or similar.

• Familiarity with orchestration, monitoring, DevOps, CI/CD, Python, containerization, Kubernetes, storage solutions, or data platform infrastructure

• Experience operationalizing analytics models, enabling data consumption, or supporting service-oriented delivery models is an advantage.

• Knowledge of power systems and the energy sector is a plus, but not a requirement.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not meet all the listed requirements. Your experience and perspective could be exactly what we are looking for.

**Working Environment

**You will join a diverse and enthusiastic team in our office at Copenhagen Towers, Ørestad. Nordic RCC is home to over twenty nationalities, with a healthy gender balance and a wide range of ages and backgrounds. We value curiosity, fellowship, respect, and transparency—and we hope you see yourself in these values.

We offer flexible work arrangements to support a healthy work-life balance, including the option to work from home part of the time. Due to the collaborative nature of our work, physical presence in the office is expected on most days.

You’ll report to Data & Analytics team-lead and collaborate regularly with colleagues from the Nordic RCC and occasionally also from the Nordic TSOs. Travel is limited and will not exceed 15 days per year.

Nordic RCC is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

**Application & Security Clearance

**Please apply online in English no later than 5 November 2026. Interviews will be conducted on a rolling basis.

To ensure a fair and unbiased recruitment process, we kindly request that you do not include photographs in your CVs or application materials.

A cover letter is not required, but we kindly ask you to include a few sentences in your CV explaining why you are interested in the position. Applications are only accepted through our online recruitment system.

Note that as part of the recruitment process, the candidate must undergo a satisfactory background check. The position is also conditioned upon a national security clearance. Both will be facilitated by Nordic RCC. You can read more on security clearance here. Please also note that the process includes that any spouse, registered partner, cohabitant, steady partner, co-resident, child over 18 living at home and parent with the same address as the candidate must also consent to be examined.   Nordic RCC is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

**Responsibilities

**Benefits

**

Join AXON Networks!

Join Connected Cars on our mission to connect millions of car owners with their vehicles by tapping into the on-board diagnostics available in every modern car.

About Connected Cars

Connected Cars is on a mission to transform how automotive manufacturers and distributors interact with their customers by turning vehicle data into loyal, lasting relationships. By 2030, our vision is to turn vehicle data into timely, personal moments that build trust and drive loyalty, while streamlining operations and boosting efficiency across the value chain.

Our team consists of around 70 people from diverse backgrounds and nationalities, brought together by a shared belief in team effort, community, and delivering quality products and solutions.

The Position

We are currently using Node.js (mainly TypeScript), Kubernetes, MySQL, and BigQuery on the backend, hosted on Google Cloud Platform. Having scaled our backend to a global presence, we rely heavily on Infrastructure as Code using Terraform. We believe in releasing early and often, supported by an automated CI/CD pipeline running multiple daily deployments.

Our engineers work in agile, cross-functional teams of 3–4 people with minimal overhead and bureaucracy. We empower our teams with full decision-making power over how they work, what they focus on, and how they deliver functionality.

As a Senior Backend Developer, you will architect and build robust APIs, backend services, and databases, while taking full ownership of your code from development to production monitoring (via Grafana and Google Cloud Monitoring). You will collaborate closely with other internal engineering teams and periodically communicate with external stakeholders to align on technical integrations and requirements.

What We're Looking For

We are seeking a skilled, autonomous engineer with 5+ years of professional backend experience who possesses an inquisitive mind and thrives on taking full ownership of complex problems. You are driven, enthusiastic about software engineering, and proactive in figuring out what needs to be built. Beyond technical execution, you enjoy working cross-functionally and act as a supportive mentor within your team to help colleagues find effective solutions.

Key qualifications and experience:

• 5+ years of experience as a backend engineer building scalable systems.

• Strong proficiency in Node.js, TypeScript, and building RESTful/GraphQL APIs.

• Solid experience with relational databases (MySQL, PostgreSQL) and managing large datasets (terabytes in BigQuery or similar).

• Proven ability to work cross-functionally and effectively communicate with external stakeholders.

• High degree of autonomy, problem-solving drive, and a natural curiosity to explore new technical solutions.

• Passion for high-quality code, TDD, CI/CD, and mentorship.

Our team is made up of people who genuinely enjoy the process of building things. If you have a GitHub account, a side project, or open-source experience, we’d love to hear about it.

Why Connected Cars

• A collaborative, innovative work environment that encourages growth, ownership, and technical autonomy.

• Competitive salary package and an attractive pension scheme.

• Friday bars, monthly social events, an affordable lunch scheme, and unlimited snacks in the office.

Connected Cars is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

Please send your application through LinkedIn with an up-to-date CV. It is not necessary to provide a cover letter, but feel free to if there is extra information you think we should know.

Do you want to make a real impact by driving DevOps transformation in a fast-growing software company?

**Your new role

**As a DevOps Specialist in the Developer Enablement team at Dalux, you will play a key role in improving the developer experience and increasing productivity as we continue to scale. Your focus will be on building, evolving, and maintaining our CI/CD pipelines and supporting infrastructure, while promoting DevOps best practices and strong software engineering principles across the organization.

You will work closely with development teams to ensure that our platforms and tooling effectively support a wide range of technologies and product areas.

**Your Responsibilities

**In this role, you will:

• Continuously improve development at Dalux by proposing and implementing new ideas and evolving our systems to better support developers

• Clarify requirements and define technical and architectural solutions in collaboration with team members

• Coach and train internal users (our developers) in using the platforms and tools we provide

• Release, operate, and maintain internal components and products

• Explore, experiment, and research new technologies to identify opportunities for technical improvement

**Our DevOps platform and tech stack

**We aim to build reliable, repeatable, and highly automated pipelines, configured and maintained as code. Our shared and customizable build systems support a broad range of teams — from mobile and web applications to image processing and backend services.

Our primary technologies include:

• Jenkins (Jenkins Pipelines, JCasC)

• GitLab and Nexus (self-hosted)

• Docker

• Hyper-V

• Prometheus, Thanos and Grafana

• MSBuild

• NPM (pnpm and Vite)

• AWS (EC2, Elastic Beanstalk, CloudFormation, S3 etc.)

Builds and tests are orchestrated using Jenkins, with code hosted in GitLab. Our platforms run on both Linux and Windows.

Dalux’ continuous growth makes the environment exciting and ever changing, but is also one of the reasons why our DevOps discipline is behind where we would like it to be.

Alongside the Developer Enablement team, we have a large DevOps Guild that supports the rollout of best practices and knowledge sharing across Dalux. Our development culture is pragmatic and agile, with frequent releases. We apply the same pragmatism to DevOps — once value is demonstrated, we move quickly to implement changes.

**Your background

**We expect that you have an educational background in Software Engineering. In addition, you have either been part of driving DevOps transformations previously and see DevOps as your strongest asset. We have open positions for both experienced DevOps profiles and developers who want to specialize further in DevOps.

**Ready for the next step?

**If Dalux sounds like a place where you could make an impact while continuing to grow as a developer, we would be happy to receive your application. Interviews are conducted on an ongoing basis.

If you have any questions, feel free to contact **IT Talent Acquisition Specialist, Katrin Nedergaard +45 92909184

**This position is open on an ongoing basis due to our continuous growth. We hire multiple candidates throughout the year and keep the position open to ensure we attract the right talent as we expand.

**About Dalux?

**Dalux is a Danish software company founded in 2005 by Ph.D. Bent Dalgaard and Torben Dalgaard. Our products are designed to make the construction industry smarter and more efficient.

Using our own 3D BIM technology, Dalux develops user-friendly digital tools that are used in more than 140 countries worldwide. We are passionate about modern technology and proud to be first movers in applying new technologies - all developed entirely in-house at Dalux.

**Join our Pizza & Beer event

**Sign-up for our free Pizza & Beer event the 29th of October 2026 at Dalux from 16:00: Pizza and Beer with Dalux

During the event, you can hear more about Dalux and the career options through presentations and mingling - all while getting delicious Pizza and beer/drinks!

**Application deadline:

**Ongoing

**WHY SPEKTR

**At spektr, we are on a mission to automate the world’s most complex compliance workflows through AI. Founded by the team behind HelloFlow (acquired by Trulioo), spektr is building the infrastructure and AI agents to run compliance at scale.

_Compliance, built like product.

_Financial services has changed enormously. Much of the technology behind compliance hasn’t. Teams still spend hours on manual checks, disconnected systems slow down launches, and entering a new market can mean rebuilding the same processes all over again.

We’re changing that. spektr gives regulated businesses one platform for onboarding, monitoring and investigations, with configurable workflows and AI agents that do the legwork. Product, Operations and Compliance can move together, with the control they need to grow.

It’s a huge opportunity in an industry that has moved slowly for too long. We’ve built a product we’re proud to put in front of the most demanding customers. Now we’re looking for people who want to help get it into their hands.

• $26M raised, including a $20M Series A led by NEA, with backing from Northzone, Seedcamp and PreSeed Ventures.

• Customers worth getting excited about. We work with businesses including Pleo, Trustly, Nexi and Santander. These are large accounts with complex problems, ambitious teams and plenty of room for us to make a difference.

• Three offices: Copenhagen, London and Iași, with customers across more than 15 countries.

**THE OPPORTUNITY

**We are looking for a DevOps Engineer to join our Platform team and help us scale infrastructure, CI/CD, and observability across our growing backend ecosystem.

You will work alongside our senior platform engineers on our Kubernetes-native stack, taking ownership of real infrastructure from early on. This is a role where you'll learn by building: our environment is modern and opinionated, and you'll be running production infrastructure for financial institutions, not sandbox projects.

We are looking for someone who is genuinely curious about how systems work, comfortable being new to things, and eager to grow fast in a high-bar environment.

**What You Will Be Doing

**

• Infrastructure as Code: Build and maintain our AWS infrastructure using Terraform/Terragrunt, starting with well-scoped modules and growing into larger architectural work.

• Kubernetes Operations: Support our EKS clusters and a rapidly growing microservices environment (NestJS backend), handling deployments, troubleshooting, and day-to-day cluster health.

• CI/CD Pipelines: Build and improve pipelines with GitHub Actions in a trunk-based development environment, so deployments stay safe and fast.

• GitOps: Work with ArgoCD-driven workflows and learn to own them end to end.

• Observability: Contribute to monitoring, alerting, and dashboards, helping us catch problems before customers do.

• Collaboration: Work closely with backend engineers and security stakeholders, applying cloud security best practices with AWS-native tooling.

**What We Are Looking For

**

• The Scale-up Mindset: You thrive in fast-moving environments and prefer building systems over following manuals.

• High-Agency Learner: You dig into problems you haven't seen before instead of waiting to be shown. You ask good questions and you don't ask the same one twice.

• Foundations: 1–3 years in DevOps, SRE, Platform, or backend engineering, or equivalent hands-on experience. A Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.

• Cloud & Containers: Working knowledge of AWS and Kubernetes. You don't need to be an expert yet, but you should be comfortable navigating both and understand what's happening underneath.

• Automation Instinct: Hands-on experience with Terraform or another IaC tool, and a preference for scripting something over doing it twice by hand.

• CI/CD Familiarity: You've worked with pipelines before, ideally GitHub Actions, and understand why deployment safety matters.

• Scripting & Systems: Comfortable with Linux, Git, and at least one scripting language (Bash, Python, or similar).

• Communication: You can explain what broke and why to an engineer who wasn't there.

**OUR TECH INTERESTS

**

• Cloud & Orchestration: AWS, Kubernetes (EKS), Helm

• IaC: Terraform, Terragrunt

• CI/CD & GitOps: GitHub/Gitlab, ArgoCD

• Observability: DataDog

**OUR PROCESS

**

• Intro call with our Talent team (30 minutes)

• Technical Interview (30 minutes)

• Technical Interview (60 minutes)

**How To Apply

**We hire the smartest, kindest, and most unrelenting people and let them do their best work. You’ll be joining a team with a proven track record and the "Product-Market Fit" to change an entire industry.

spektr is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, religion, disability, sexual orientation or any other characteristic, and we assess every candidate against the same role requirements.

Location: Copenhagen, Denmark ( DANISH SPEAKING )

Employment: Permanent

Start: ASAP

We are looking for a Renewable Energy Solution Engineer to support technical projects within Solar PV, Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS), Data Centers, EV Charging Networks and Power Distribution Networks across the Nordic region.

The role combines technical solution implementation, system integration, testing, verification and project delivery with customer engagement, partner collaboration and commercial sales support.

Responsibilities

• Take responsibility for system integration, implementation, testing, verification and project acceptance

• Support technical solution design, including platform deployment and integration verification

• Support business and system surveys for industry solution projects

• Coordinate solution implementation with customers, partners and technical teams

• Support project bidding, service solutions and sales activities across the Nordic region

• Collaborate with headquarters and Nordic teams on service solutions and sales strategies

• Support service operations, customer experience and training of service partners

Requirements

• More than 3 years of experience in the renewable energy or data center industry

• Experience in solution design, service architecture design, delivery implementation or service integration

Technical knowledge

General renewable energy industry knowledge and basic product knowledge in at least one of the following areas:

The Company

˚MEQU is a Danish MedTech company behind the ˚M Warmer System, an innovative medical device that enables healthcare professionals to deliver warm blood and IV-fluids from the point of injury to the hospital. With customers across military, tactical, emergency, HEMS, and hospital environments worldwide, our ambition is to become the global leader in blood and IV-fluid warming solutions for pre-hospital and through hospital care. Learn more about ˚MEQU: www.mequ.dk

On behalf of ˚MEQU, Best Talent is recruiting an International Product Manager.

The Team

You will join a small, ambitious Marketing team with ambitious plans and great impact on the future growth of the company. Success is driven by close collaboration across Marketing, R&D, QA/RA, Operations, and Commercial functions in a fast moving and highly cross-functional environment.

International Product Manager

Drive global product strategy for an innovative Danish MedTech company

• Shape life-saving MedTech solutions through your clinical expertise

• Collaborate with leading healthcare providers, emergency services, and military organizations

The Role

We are looking for an International Product Manager who can bridge clinical insights, users’ needs, regulatory requirements, and technical development to drive successful global product strategies and commercial execution.

You will own the global product lifecycle across emergency, tactical, and hospital segments. With the United States representing ˚MEQU’s most important growth market, you will play a key role in ensuring that product positioning, roadmap priorities, and value propositions algin with the clinical, regulatory, and commercial requirements of US military, EMS, HEMS, and hospital customers.

Working across the organization, you will ensure that user insights, market needs, engineering priorities and regulatory considerations are translated into clear product direction and commercially viable solutions.

As the internal subject-matter expert within pre-hospital blood and IV transfusion, you will convert clinical challenges into prioritized product requirements that guide product development and long-term portfolio decisions. The position reports directly to the COO and requires approximately 30-50 travel days annually.

Your key responsibilities will include:

• Shaping global product positioning, value propositions, and market prioritization to support successful international expansion, and continuously monitor:

• Developments in clinical standards of care.

• Tactical and military medical protocols.

• Global procurement and reimbursement structures.

• Competitive and technological developments.

• International market dynamics and commercial opportunities.

• Develop instructions for use, training materials, user guides, and educational content to support sales teams, distributors, and clinical specialists globally.

Your professional background:

You bring a clinical background within emergency medicine, pre-hospital care, HEMS, military medicine, or tactical care, combined with hands-on experience with blood and IV transfusion in critical settings. You understand the realities and challenges faced by end users in high-pressure environments.

In addition, you have commercial insight into the MedTech industry and experience supporting product positioning, launches, and international market development. Experience working with institutional customers medical device markets and understand how to position, launch, and scale products internationally. Experience with institutional and public procurement structures is highly valued.

You understand medical device development and the regulatory environment and are able to translate complex clinical needs into structured product requirements that create both customers value and commercial impact.

Your personality – You are:

• A strong communicator with who bridges clinical technical, regulatory, and commercial perspectives.

• Commercially minded with a strategic and customer-centric approach

• Structured and analytical, with the ability to balance long-term strategy and operational execution

• Proactive, self-driven, and comfortable taking ownership in a dynamic scale-up environment

• Curious, collaborative, and motivated by improving patient outcomes through innovation

˚MEQU offers you:

You will gain international exposure across tactical, emergency, and hospital markets and collaborate closely with global distributors, armed forces, and leading healthcare institutions.

• A high-impact position with global strategic product influence

• A dynamic, international, and collaborative work environment

• A diverse team of 30+ colleagues headquartered in Copenhagen

• A mission-driven culture focused on improving patient outcomes

• Competitive salary with a pension scheme and up-to-date benefits

jobs.occupation: Event & Experience Manager – Bring Axlab’s customer experiences to life
jobs.description:
Can you turn a showroom visit, a reference site tour or an industry exhibition into an experience that makes a lasting impression?

In collaboration with Actief Hartmanns, Axlab is looking for an Event & Experience Manager who combines creative design with hands-on delivery and a clear commercial focus.

In the position you will own Axlab’s customer-facing experience programme: reference site visits, the headquarters showroom, Axlab Academy, and industry exhibitions. This is an opportunity to combine concept development with practical execution, shaping how visitors experience Axlab’s solutions and building the calendar, materials and processes that ensure consistent quality and continuity.

Your role goes beyond logistics: you will design welcoming, relevant experiences that help visitors understand how Axlab’s solutions work in practice. You will also build the calendar, materials and documented processes that make the programme consistent, scalable, and less dependent on any one individual.

You will be part of the Marcom team and work closely with Sales, Product Management, and external partners. Together with the Graphic Designer & Event Coordinator, you will translate ideas into a strong exhibition presence and cohesive creative execution.

What you will take ownership of

• 
Develop and deliver reference site visits, showroom tours, Academy days and exhibitions that connect customer needs with Axlab’s automated pathology workflows.

• 
Establish and continually improve the showroom experience and reference site concept for prospective and existing customers.

• 
Manage programmes and events from concept to delivery, aligning internal teams, external agencies, and production partners.

• 
Build and maintain the activity calendar, supporting materials, briefings, and documented processes.

• 
Manage suppliers, budgets, and negotiations, with close attention to production details and on-site logistics.

• 
Track event performance and work with Sales and within Marcom to ensure effective lead handling and handover.

• 
Help support the development of a sustainable webinar approach that contributes to sales opportunities.

What you bring

You have at least five years of experience in event management, experiential marketing, or customer experience, ideally combining large-scale exhibitions with smaller, hosted experiences. Exhibition or trade show experience is essential, together with relevant experience from the medical device industry. You can demonstrate that you have designed and delivered premium customer or partner experiences, not simply coordinated the logistics.

• 
A bachelor’s degree or higher in marketing, communications, business, hospitality, or event management, or equivalent experience.

• 
Experience establishing and improving a showroom for a company providing anatomic pathology equipment or a medical device company.

• 
Experience developing and refining reference site concepts for prospective and existing customers.

• 
Strong end-to-end project management skills and the ability to collaborate with Sales, Product Management, and external partners.

• 
Experience managing vendors, suppliers, and budgets, including negotiations with agencies and production partners.

• 
Confidence reporting on event performance, handling leads and coordinates their handover.

• 
Fluency in English. Danish is an advantage when working with headquarters and the local reference site network.

Experience developing a webinar strategy that generates sales opportunities is a plus. Alternatively, you are comfortable learning this skill quickly, as you will work closely with your future colleagues in Marcom on this.

Regular travel should be expected, and in busy periods, this can be 50% or more.

A thoughtful host with a hands-on mindset

You make people feel genuinely welcome and adapt naturally to different visitors and situations. You stay calm when plans change, take pride in the details and are just as comfortable shaping an experience concept as managing the on-site logistics. Open and approachable, you build trust with colleagues, suppliers and senior stakeholders, communicate clear briefs, and know who needs which information — and when.

You bring creativity, initiative and a collaborative approach. You are curious about what works, use data and feedback to improve the programme and look for ways to make each visit or event meaningful rather than routine.

Axlab’s Marcom team works to build recognition of the Axlab brand for bringing innovation and automation to pathology laboratories in its direct markets. Through consistent brand storytelling, impactful events, customer experiences and digital channels, the team connects colleagues and customers with that ambition. In this role, you will have ownership of the experiences that show what it means in practice.

What we offer

We are a small yet ambitious growth company where our shared values — Decency, Innovation, Commitment, and Responsibility — form the foundation of everything we do. We offer a flexible, hybrid, and trust-based full-time position where you will have influence on both your own role and the continued development of our Marcom function . Occasional travel activity must be expected as part of the role.

• 
Competitive salary and employment conditions

• 
A highly visible role with direct access to senior leadership

• 
Influence on business decisions and strategic initiatives

• 
Professional and personal development opportunities

• 
An international and collaborative working environment

• 
Welcoming and comfortable office space with everyday perks including free refreshments and daily lunch buffet

• 
Social activities and annual global events
